title: when a changed file's signature change makes the base overlay fail to build, say so in the Base overlays section instead of offering it as a revert check

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
When a slice changes a signature, adds a struct field that its tests read, or moves a helper that other files use, the base overlay for one changed file does not build. The reviewer reported this as friction in run ork-20261125-203302-a88e, item S586. Overlays 1 and 2 failed with "not enough arguments in call to engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist / CloudUIAllowlist". The reviewer ran the `go test -overlay` command that the brief's `## Base overlays` section offered and got a build error. It was not a red test, so the command proved nothing.

The owner merged S577 (undefined `heldNote`), S591 (`pane.page` undefined) and S593 here and decided the fix. Before listing a command, ork runs `go vet` with each overlay. An overlay that fails to build is listed as `does not build: ERROR` and gets no revert command. This is advisory, like the rest of the section, and it never blocks the run.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-25: adj 585 (any non-zero go vet exit on an overlay is shown as does not build: ERROR with the first output lines).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
All tests are in `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go` and use a fake `go` tool routed by the harness.
- TestBaseOverlayVetsEachOverlayFirst: the slice changes `internal/x/a.go` and `internal/x/b.go`, and the fake `go` exits 0 for both. The fake receives exactly two calls, in sorted order, with args `-C WORKTREE vet -overlay TMPDIR/overlay-N.json ./internal/x` for N = 1 and 2. Both entries still carry their `go -C WORKTREE test -overlay ...` command.
- TestBaseOverlayBuildFailureReplacesCommand: the fake `go` exits 0 for the first file and exits 1 with stderr `# pkg\ninternal/x/b.go:12:5: not enough arguments in call to engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` for the second. The second entry contains `does not build: ` and the error text. It has no `test -overlay` command, and it names `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:internal/x/b.go`. The first entry keeps its command, and the intro text ("only that file reverted", "-run NAME", "one test per command") is still present.
- TestBaseOverlayNoIntroWhenNothingBuilds: every overlay fails vet. The body lists `does not build` entries and has no `go -C` test command, no "-run NAME" and no "Each command runs" intro.
- TestBaseOverlayBuildErrorIsOneShortLine: stderr of 10 lines, each over 300 characters. The entry holds no newline and no pipe, shows at most 3 non-empty lines each cut to 200 characters, and ends with the `git show` pointer on the same line.
- TestBaseOverlayNewFileBuildFailureKeepsNote: a file new in the slice whose overlay fails vet. The entry keeps "(new in this slice; the overlay hides it)" and also says `does not build: `.
- TestBaseOverlayVetCannotRunKeepsCommand: `h.deps.GoBin` points at a path that does not exist, so `go` cannot start. The entry keeps its test command, the section has no `does not build` text, and the run still reaches `StateAwaitingApproval`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `internal/engine/engine.go`: add `GoBin string // empty means "go"` to `Deps`, and `func (d Deps) goBin() string` next to `gitBin`.
2. `internal/clitest/clitest.go`: add `"go"` to the tool list that `Install` symlinks (line 105) and to the tool check in `Main` (line 134), so a test can route `go` calls. Add no other behavior.
3. `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go`: add `const baseOverlayVetTimeout = 2 * time.Minute`.
4. `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go`: add `func (e *Engine) overlayBuildError(ctx context.Context, rec runrec.Record, overlayFile, pkg string) string`.
   - It runs `clirun.Run` with `Bin: e.d.goBin()`, `Args: ["-C", rec.Worktree, "vet", "-overlay", overlayFile, pkg]` and `Timeout: baseOverlayVetTimeout`.
   - It returns "" on success.
   - On `*clirun.ExitError` it returns a one-line message built from stderr, or from stdout when stderr is empty. The message is the first 3 non-empty lines, each cut to 200 characters, joined with `; `. If both are empty it returns `go vet exit N`.
   - For any other error (go not found, timeout) it returns "", so the command is offered unchanged. This is advisory, as in the rest of the file.
5. `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go`, in `baseOverlaySection`:
   - After `writeBaseOverlay` succeeds, call `overlayBuildError` with the same overlay path and `packageArg(p)` that the command uses.
   - When the message is non-empty, append `- `p`` (with the new-file note when `isNew`) `: does not build: MESSAGE. Trace its base version with `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:p` instead.` and do not build the command.
   - Keep the overlay file, and keep the numbering `len(entries)+1`.
   - Count the entries that carry a command. Write the intro paragraph ("Each command runs one package's tests...") only when that count is above zero.
6. `internal/engine/harness_test.go`:
   - Set `GoBin: fake.Bin("go")` in `h.deps`.
   - Add a default route to the harness routes: `clitest.Route{Tool: "go", Args: []string{"-C", W, "vet"}, Prefix: true}` (exit 0), after the `routesFor` routes so a test's own route wins.
   - New tests route `go` with a `Seq` of replies, one per overlay in sorted order.
7. `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`: add the six tests above. Existing tests pass unchanged through the default exit-0 route.
8. `docs/design.md`, in the `## Base overlays` bullet (lines 2041-2058): add that ork first runs `go -C WORKTREE vet -overlay TMPDIR/overlay-N.json ./DIR` for each overlay. An overlay whose vet exits non-zero is listed as `does not build: ERROR` with a `git show` pointer and no command. A vet that cannot run leaves the command in place. Mark it with the slice id.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Acceptance: with the fake go exiting 0 the Base overlays section is unchanged from before. With a failing vet the entry reads does not build: ERROR and has no test -overlay command. A go that cannot run changes nothing.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayVetsEachOverlayFirst ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayBuildFailureReplacesCommand ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNoIntroWhenNothingBuilds ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayBuildErrorIsOneShortLine ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNewFileBuildFailureKeepsNote ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayVetCannotRunKeepsCommand ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test ./...` passes.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing and exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In the next reviewer round for a slice that changes a signature, open the reviewer's brief under the run's role files. The ## Base overlays section should show does not build: ... with the compiler error for the file whose revert cannot compile. That entry should have no go -C ... test -overlay command. The other files should keep their commands.
